dialogue.title: Research framing
dialogue.body: Explain the spatial pattern of Shanghai street vitality without hiding consequential data or model choices.

dialogue.title: Evidence branch
dialogue.body: I separated built-form evidence from local-opportunity evidence and audited what each variable measures across space, time, and people.

dialogue.title: Model branch
dialogue.body: Residual geography triggered GWR and GWRF branches. Their fitted or local validation scores are not treated as interchangeable with contiguous spatial-block transfer.

dialogue.title: Authorization
dialogue.body: Use RF for the primary association; retain GWR and the selected GWRF setting as bounded local diagnostics; block causal and population-wide claims.

claim_options.primary: RF supplies the spatial-holdout-backed within-city association claim.
claim_options.local_linear: GWR supplies coefficient geography only; its fitted R2 is not used to select the primary model.
claim_options.local_nonlinear: GWRF k=120 is retained as a bounded local sensitivity branch under the measured runtime budget.
claim_options.blocked: No branch supports causal effects, resident-population inference, or a universal local mechanism.
